title: humboltia delicatula
intro: Humboltia delicatula, commonly known as Humboldt's Yellow or Yellow Pea, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America, belonging to the family Convolvulaceae. The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the management of conditions like arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Humboldt's Yellow include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Humboldt's Yellow include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in modern pharmacological research.
